Resolutions of 1994

77 resolutions, 81% unanimous. Humanitarian wars and failures.

  • 893 (1994) Deployment of the UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda and implementation of the Arusha Peace Agreement
  • 894 (1994) Participation of the UN and international observers in the election process in South Africa
  • 895 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 896 (1994) Possible establishment of a peace-keeping force in Abkhazia, Georgia and on political settlement of the Abkhazia conflict
  • 897 (1994) Continuation of the UN Operation in Somalia II and the process of national reconciliation, reconstruction and political settlement in Somalia
  • 898 (1994) Establishment of a UN police component of the UN Operation in Mozambique and implementation of the General Peace agreement for Mozambique
  • 899 (1994) Compensation payments to the Iraqi private citizens whose assets remained on Kuwaiti territory following the demarcation of the boundary between Iraq and Kuwait
  • 900 (1994) Restoration of essential public services and normal life in and around Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
  • 901 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Georgia
  • 902 (1994) Achieving of an agreement on the confidence-building measures relating to Varosha and Nicosia International Airport, Cyprus
  • 903 (1994) Extension of the mandate and increase of the strength of the UN Angola Verification Mission II
  • 904 (1994) Measures to guarantee the safety and protection of the Palestinian civilians in territories occupied by Israel
  • 905 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Haiti
  • 906 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Georgia and on political settlement of the situation in Abkhazia, Georgia
  • 907 (1994) The referendum for self-determination of the people of Western Sahara
  • 908 (1994) Extension of the mandate and increase of the personnel of the UN Protection Force
  • 909 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda and implementation of the Arusha Peace Agreement
  • 910 (1994) An exemption from the provisions of paragraph 4 of resolution 748 (1992) in respect of UN aircraft flying to or from the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya for the purpose of conveying the Secretary-General's reconnaissance team
  • 911 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Liberia and implementation of the Peace Agreement for Liberia
  • 912 (1994) Adjustment of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda due to the current situation in Rwanda and settlement of the Rwandan conflict
  • 913 (1994) The situation in Bosnia and Herzegovina, particularly in the safe area of Gorazde and political settlement of the situation in the former Yugoslavia
  • 914 (1994) Increase of the personnel of the UN Protection Force, in addition to the reinforcement approved in resolution 908 (1994)
  • 915 (1994) Establishment of the UN Aouzou Strip Observer Group to observe implementation of the agreement signed on 4 Apr. 1994 at Surt, Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, in accordance with the recommendations of the Secretary-General and paragraph 9 of resolution 907 (1994)
  • 916 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Operation in Mozambique and implementation of the General Peace Agreement for Mozambique
  • 917 (1994) Expansion of the sanctions until the return of the legitimately elected President to Haiti
  • 918 (1994) Expansion of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda and imposition of an arms embargo on Rwanda
  • 919 (1994) Termination of the arms embargo and other restrictions related to South Africa imposed by resolution 418 (1977)
  • 920 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in El Salvador and implementation of the Peace Accords and other agreements relating to the El Salvador peace process
  • 921 (1994) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 922 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Angola Verification Mission II and a comprehensive peace settlement in Angola
  • 923 (1994) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Operation in Somalia II and process of national reconciliation in Somalia
  • 924 (1994) Calling for a cease-fire in Yemen, and requesting the Secretary-General to send a fact-finding mission
  • 925 (1994) Extension of the mandate and deployment of the two additional battalions of the UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda and settlement of the conflict in Rwanda
  • 926 (1994) Termination of the UN Aouzou Strip Observer Group
  • 927 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus and implementation of confidence-building measures between the parties in Cyprus
  • 928 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission Uganda-Rwanda
  • 929 (1994) Establishment of a temporary multinational operation for humanitarian purposes in Rwanda until the deployment of the expanded UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda
  • 930 (1994) Termination of the UN Observer Mission in South Africa and removal of the item "The question of South Africa" from the list of matters of which the Security Council is seized
  • 931 (1994) An immediate and durable cease-fire in Yemen
  • 932 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Angola Verification Mission II
  • 933 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Haiti
  • 934 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Georgia
  • 935 (1994) Requesting the Secretary-General to establish a Commission of Experts to examine violations of international humanitarian law committed in Rwanda
  • 936 (1994) Appointment of Richard J. Goldtone as Prosecutor of the International Tribunal for the Prosecution of Persons Responsible for Serious Violations of International Humanitarian Law Committed in the Territory of the Former Yugoslavia since 1991
  • 937 (1994) Expansion and extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Georgia and its cooperation with the CIS peace-keeping force
  • 938 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 939 (1994) Settlement of the Cyprus question including implementation of confidence-building measures between the two communities
  • 940 (1994) Authorization to form a multinational force under unified command and control to restore the legitimately elected President and authorities of the Government of Haiti and extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Haiti
  • 941 (1994) Violations of international humanitarian law in Banja Luka, Bijeljina and other areas of Bosnia and Herzegovina under the control of Bosnian Serb forces
  • 942 (1994) Reinforcement and extension of measures imposed by the Security Council resolutions with regard to those areas of Bosnia and Herzegovina under the control of Bosnian Serb forces, to assist the parties to give effect to the proposed territorial settlement in Bosnia and Herzegovina
  • 943 (1994) Closure of the border between the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and Bosnia and Herzegovina with respect to all goods except foodstuffs, medical supplies and clothing for essential humanitarian needs
  • 944 (1994) Termination of the measures regarding Haiti set out in resolutions 841 (1993), 873 (1993) and 917 (1994) after the return to Haiti of President Jean-Bertrand Aristide
  • 945 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Angola Verification Mission II and continuation of the efforts aimed at the earliest resolution of the Angolan crisis through negotiations within the framework of the Peace Accords
  • 946 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Operation in Somalia II
  • 947 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Protection Force and requesting the Secretary-General to report on progress towards implementation of the UN Peace-keeping Plan for Croatia and all relevant Security Council resolutions
  • 948 (1994) Restoration of democracy in Haiti, return of President Jean-Bertrand Aristide and lifting of the sanctions in accordance with resolution 944 (1994)
  • 949 (1994) Demanding that Iraq immediately complete the withdrawal of all military units recently deployed to southern Iraq to their original positions and that Iraq not again utilize its military or any other forces in a hostile or provocative manner to threaten its neighbours or UN operations in Iraq
  • 950 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in Liberia and peace process in Liberia
  • 951 (1994) Election to fill a vacancy in the International Court of Justice
  • 952 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Angola Verification Mission II and reaching of an agreement for establishing an effective and sustainable cease-fire as a matter of urgency
  • 953 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Operation in Somalia II
  • 954 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Operation in Somalia II for a final period until 31 Mar. 1995 and secure withdrawal of personnel and assets from Somalia
  • 955 (1994) Establishment of an International Tribunal for Rwanda and adoption of the Statute of the Tribunal
  • 956 (1994) Termination of the status of Palau as a Trust Territory
  • 957 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Operation in Mozambique until the new Government of Mozambique takes office and completion of the residual operations prior to the withdrawal of the UN Operation in Mozambique on or before 31 Jan. 1995
  • 958 (1994) The decision that the authorization given in paragraph 10 of resolution 836 (1993) to assist the UN Protection Force in carrying out its mandate in Bosnia and Herzegovina shall apply also to such measures taken in Croatia
  • 959 (1994) Efforts of the UN Protection Force to ensure implementation of Security Council resolutions on safe areas in Bosnia and Herzegovina
  • 960 (1994) Endorsement of the results of the free and fair elections in Mozambique
  • 961 (1994) The final extension of the mandate of the UN Observer Mission in El Salvador and implementation of all aspects of the Peace Accords for El Salvador
  • 962 (1994) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 963 (1994) Admission of Palau to membership in the United Nations
  • 964 (1994) Authorization to strengthen the advance team of the UN Mission in Haiti
  • 965 (1994) Extension and expansion of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission for Rwanda
  • 966 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Angola Verification Mission II and monitoring of the compliance with the cease-fire in Angola
  • 967 (1994) Exemption from the provisions of resolution 757 (1992) permitting the export of diphtheria anti-serum from the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia for a period of 30 days from the date of the adoption of this resolution
  • 968 (1994) Establishment of a UN Mission of Observers in Tajikistan and on the process of national reconciliation
  • 969 (1994) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus and implementation of confidence-building measures between the parties in Cyprus
